meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装了这个技能,Claude 能实际操作一个浏览器:打开网址、点按钮、填表单、截图、读取网页文字并提取数据,也能执行网页自动化测试。
howto.when: 当用户要在浏览器里打开某个网址、对页面做操作,或从页面提取信息时,Claude 会用浏览器技能来完成。

say.text: 打开 example.com,然后给首页截图
say.note: 它会启动浏览器并保存截图。

say.text: 在 example.com/form 上填好邮箱和密码,再点提交
say.note: 它会依次填入字段并点击提交按钮。

say.text: 截取当前页面,并把可点击元素标上编号
say.note: 输出图会为可交互元素叠加上标号。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can drive a real browser: open URLs, click buttons, fill in and submit forms, take screenshots, extract text or data from web pages, and run browser-based automation tests.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to open a URL in the browser, operate the page, or extract information from the page, Claude uses browser automation to do it.

say_en.text: Open example.com and screenshot the homepage.
say_en.note: It starts a browser and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: On example.com/form, enter the email and password, then submit.
say_en.note: It fills the fields and presses submit.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of this page, numbering each clickable element.
